Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 0  
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer misinterpreted the status of the American Airlines Shuttle as active, despite its discontinuation in 2021, leading to incorrect data being used in subsequent steps. This mistake caused an irrecoverable error, as subsequent agents relied on this incorrect information, resulting in the wrong final conclusion.
